Overall, the checkpoint evaluation is sound, confirming the object functions visually as a diaper despite being on a doll.
artifact_review: The Router identified a critical 'structural_collapse' in the left arm (severity 3.0). The Router also noted texture anomalies in the hat (severity 2.0), which aligns with the general 'waxy' or soft-focus look often seen in AI generations. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no graphic distortions, but this expert cannot detect structural fusion. The Router's severity rating for the arm is appropriate—it's a clear anatomical failure of the subject (doll), even if the class (diaper) is intact. I agree with the severity ratings; the arm defect is significant enough to lower the artifact score substantially.

The fact that it is on a doll does not negate the class alignment of the garment itself. 6/7 testable checkpoints passed effectively.
